inputs.name: astrolabe-processed
inputs.note: SPARC rotation curves, the Milky Way rotation curve and JPL ephemerides, read from astrolabe's processed store. The legacy sims take the path with --data; their built-in default still looks for the retired sibling orrery/astrolabe checkout layout.

note: Legacy multi-sim record: 24 sims, most of them seeded lattice or symbolic checks with no input bytes.
